says: The no-crash test for the one-store-hook rule runs the repo's whole lint config on a file that holds a bare `helper;` (line 86) and expects no diagnostic from any rule, so eslint/no-unused-expressions cannot be turned on though the tree has 0 hits
proof: added `"eslint/no-unused-expressions": "error"` to .oxlintrc.json and ran `vitest run next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/one-store-hook.test.ts`: 1 failed, 13 passed; the failure is line 178, `expected 1 to be +0`, with one eslint(no-unused-expressions) diagnostic on other-calls.ts line 6. The same rule alone over the tree printed no problem
cost: a rule with no hits stays off because one test asserts more than its own law; any later built-in rule that reads that planted file is blocked the same way

says: catchup.sh merges main in once, then waits for the checks; when main moves during that wait GitHub refuses the squash, the script exits 1 at this line, and a second run by hand is needed
proof: the main ruleset has strict_required_status_checks_policy true (`gh api repos/<repo>/rulesets/<id>`), and the script has no second merge of main after its wait. Three pull requests merged on 2026-11-10 each carry two `Merge main into` commits from two runs: 665 (08:01:09Z and 08:03:27Z), 702 (06:43:29Z and 07:06:07Z, main moved at 06:52:35Z) and 696 (06:11:46Z and 06:53:10Z, main moved at 06:17:11Z). Seen again on pull request 723: after a 9 minute wait with every check green, the run printed `merge refused: ... is not mergeable: the head branch is not up to date with the base branch` and exited 1
cost: with about twelve agents landing work, a catch-up can lose its whole wait for CI and needs an agent to start it again; each retry is one more full CI run

says: Signed links are matched by a bare ticket number, and lanes of 2026-11-08 signed under numbers the tracker had not reached, so a new tracker ticket with one of those numbers gets `stale_link` for a step its branch never ran
proof: pull request 722, lead commits only under tracker ticket 517: the commits check printed `commits: stuck stale_link 0018c82dfef3140c418347cbce3a9157ecc924c9 step tests` (Actions run 42783542604). refs/notes/fabrika holds two `tests` links for ticket 517 on commits of 2026-11-08 from another branch (02d15257, c69e8080). The same notes hold older tests or build links under 518, 520, 538, 540, 546 and 556, and the tracker's newest ticket is 523
cost: the same work had to be signed again under a new ticket and opened as a second pull request; open tickets 518 and 520 will hit it too, and 538, 540, 546 and 556 when the tracker reaches them

says: catchup.sh merges main into the head once, waits up to an hour for checks, then squashes pinned to the head only; it never reads main again, and the ruleset's up-to-date rule is bypassed by the merging role, so a pull request lands on a main its checks never saw
proof: PR 736: its check job log says `HEAD is now at 882abc9 Merge d878f7a1c7e0ceab178903b6a18747f7e8a03bc0 into 31f57ddfd7fb488a05fd53bd4a4ea97430551b48` and `All matched files use the correct format. Finished in 270ms on 1303 files`; PR 729 landed on main as 49e84ef65 at 09:54:28Z and added clauderow.test.ts; PR 736 was squashed as b24f989be at 10:01:39Z with no new catch-up. `gh api repos/usirin/tea-fabrika/rulesets/rule-suites/5017407739` printed result `bypass`, with required_status_checks `fail`. Main's run 42795622646 failed `pnpm lint`: `Format issues found in above 1 files`. Run again here with the same oxfmt flags: exit 0 on d878f7a1 merged with 31f57ddf (1303 files), exit 1 on b24f989be (1304 files). Of the last 20 merges to main, 12 had a head behind main by 1 to 6 commits, and those 12 are exactly the rule suites with result `bypass`
cost: any blocking check can pass on a pull request and fail on main after the merge; today one such merge turned main's lint red until PR 742, and 11 more landed untested on their final tree
